name: McIntire Garrison House

dates.note: Four sources give four dates and none is edited to agree with another. The HABS data sheet prints 'Date of Erection 1660-1692' and the loc.gov item's own summary line repeats it as 'Building/structure dates: 1660-1692 Initial Construction'. The Maine Historic Preservation Commission's page is headed 'McIntire Garrison, c.1707'. SAH Archipedia's entry opens '1707'. The Wikipedia infobox says 'Built 1713' while the same article's first sentence says 'Built in 1712'. The survey's own history is the reason for the spread: it says the building 'aas standing in 1682' (OCR for 'was') and quotes a deed of 27 June 1707 describing land 'bounded l^y "the orchard or garden of ad Ihraaaell where the Garrison now stands"' ('l^y' is the sheet's OCR for 'by').
dates.altered: The survey's Present Condition records that the east wall has been shingled, the roof re-shingled and the chimney rebuilt, that windows have been enlarged and doors replaced since original construction, and that a kitchen extension at the west end was torn down about 1903.

note: This record exists because of a disagreement, and the disagreement is the point. Two sources describe two different buildings on one site: HABS calls it 'A two story frame building', while Wikipedia calls it 'a New England colonial log garrison house' and the Maine Historic Preservation Commission 'a two-story side-gabled log building'. Neither is edited. What all of them agree on is the second storey projecting, and only HABS puts a number on it: approximately fourteen inches, all around. That figure is why the building is carried on both garrison-colonial and garrison-revival -- it is the measured original against which a revival overhang can be called shallow -- and it is also evidence against garrison-colonial's own prose, which says the genuine garrison houses 'generally did not have jetties'. The survey filed the house under the village name Scotland and the road as South Berwick Road; Wikipedia, SAH Archipedia and the state preservation office all give Cider Hill Road, which is the form both style nodes print.
